title: 4Sum
statement_md: Given an array `nums` of `n` integers, return an array of all the **unique** quadruplets `[nums[a], nums[b], nums[c], nums[d]]` such that `nums[a] + nums[b] + nums[c] + nums[d] == target`.
editorial_md:
### Method: Recursive kSum with Two Pointers
- **Time Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(N^{k-1})$
- **Space Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(N)$
